title: Move a project
subtitle: Move a project and everything under it to another server.
repointDns: Point the DNS records at the new server too

blocker.same_server: The project is already on that server.
blocker.empty_project: There is nothing on that server to move.
blocker.items_on_several_servers: The project is on several servers. Choose the one to move from.
blocker.agent_offline_source: The agent on the current server is offline.
blocker.agent_offline_target: The agent on the target server is offline.
blocker.server_not_ready: A server is not online yet.
blocker.db_engine_unsupported: A database engine cannot be copied by backup.
blocker.db_needs_s3_destination: A database needs a backup destination (S3) that both servers can reach.
blocker.db_extra_volumes: A database has extra volumes that a backup does not carry.
blocker.db_linked_outside: An app outside this project uses one of its databases.
blocker.app_move_active: An app already has a move running.
blocker.project_move_active: This project already has a move running.

warning.app_redeploy_after_relink: {ref} is redeployed after it is linked to its new database.
warning.pitr_not_carried: {ref}: point-in-time recovery is not carried to the new database.
warning.db_config_only: {ref} was never deployed: only its settings move.
warning.items_left_behind: Some items of this project are on other servers and stay where they are.

failure.db_copy_failed: A database copy did not come up.
failure.app_move_failed: An app could not be moved.
failure.app_move_rolled_back: An app move was rolled back.
failure.verify_failed: The move finished but the check found a problem. See the report.
failure.partial_move: Some items moved and some did not. Nothing was undone for you.
failure.rollback_incomplete: The move could not be fully undone. Look at each item.

check.app_running: The app is running on the new server
check.db_running: The database is running on the new server
check.db_relinked: The apps are linked to the new database
check.safety_copy_kept: The old copy is kept as a safety copy

safety: The old copy is kept until {date}.

error.forbidden: Only a team owner can move a project.
error.preflight_failed: The move cannot start. See what stops it.
error.project_move_active: This project already has a move running.
error.move_not_cancellable: This move can no longer be cancelled.
error.move_not_completed: Only a finished move has an old copy.
error.nothing_to_purge: The old copy was already removed.
error.confirm_name_mismatch: That is not the project's name.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.

confirmBody: This stops {n} running items for a short time, copies the data and moves the project to {server}. The old copy stays for {days} days.
purgeBody: This removes the old databases and the old app volumes that were kept as a safety copy.
